regions.name: Faranah
regions.title: Faranah Region
text: Faranah Region (N'Ko: ߝߙߊߣߊ߫ ߕߌ߲߬ߞߎߘߎ߲) is located in east-central Guinea. It is bordered by the countries of Sierra Leone and Mali and the Guinean regions of Kankan, Mamou, Nzérékoré, and Labé.

regions.name: Kindia
regions.title: Kindia Region
text: Kindia Region (Pular: 𞤁𞤭𞥅𞤱𞤢𞤤 𞤑𞤭𞤲𞤣𞤭𞤴𞤢𞥄) is a region located in western Guinea. It is bordered by the country of Sierra Leone and the Guinean regions of Conakry, Labé, Mamou, and Boké.

regions.name: Mamou Prefecture
regions.title: Mamou Prefecture
text: Mamou (Pular: 𞤍𞤢𞤤𞤭𞥅𞤪𞤫 𞤃𞤢𞥄𞤥𞤵𞤲) is a prefecture located in the Mamou Region of Guinea. The capital is Mamou. The prefecture covers an area of 8,000 km.² and has an estimated population of 222,000.

regions.name: Dabola Prefecture
regions.title: Dabola Prefecture
text: Dabola is a prefecture located in the Faranah Region of Guinea. The capital is Dabola. The prefecture covers an area of 6,350 km.² and has an estimated population of 182,951.

regions.name: Forécariah Prefecture
regions.title: Forécariah Prefecture
text: Forécariah is a prefecture located in the Kindia Region of Guinea. The capital is Forécariah. The prefecture covers an area of 4,384 km2 and has a 2014 census population of 242,942.

regions.name: Guéckédou Prefecture
regions.title: Guéckédou Prefecture
text: Guéckédou is a prefecture located in the Nzérékoré Region of Guinea. The capital is Guéckédou. The prefecture covers an area of 4,750 km.² and has a population of 290,611.

regions.name: Kankan
regions.title: Kankan Region
text: Kankan Region (N'Ko: ߞߊ߲ߞߊ߲߫ ߕߌ߲߬ߞߎߘߎ߲) is a region of Guinea located in the east of the country. It is the largest region of Guinea by area, covering an area of 72,145 km2; and it had a population of 4,110,215 at the Census on 1 July 2025. The region is divided into five prefectures (Kankan, Kérouané, Kouroussa, Mandiana and Siguiri).
It is bordered by the countries of Mali and Côte d'Ivoire and the Guinean regions of Nzérékoré and Faranah.

regions.name: Mandiana Prefecture
regions.title: Mandiana Prefecture
text: Mandiana is a prefecture located in the Kankan Region of Guinea. The capital is Mandiana. The prefecture covers an area of 12,825 km.² and has a population of 335,999.

regions.name: Beyla Prefecture
regions.title: Beyla Prefecture
text: Beyla is a prefecture located in the Nzérékoré Region of Guinea. The capital is Beyla. The prefecture covers an area of 13,612 km.² and has an estimated population of 326,082.

regions.name: Lola Prefecture
regions.title: Lola Prefecture
text: Lola is a prefecture located in the Nzérékoré Region of Guinea. The capital is Lola. The prefecture covers an area of 4,688 km² and has a population of 171,561.

regions.name: Koundara Prefecture
regions.title: Koundara Prefecture
text: Koundara is a prefecture located in the Boké Region of Guinea. The capital is Koundara. The prefecture covers an area of 5,238 km2 (2,022 sq mi) and has a population of 130,205.

regions.name: Mali Prefecture
regions.title: Mali Prefecture
text: Not to be confused with the Republic of Mali.

Mali (Pular: 𞤍𞤢𞤤𞤭𞥅𞤪𞤫 𞤃𞤢𞥄𞤤𞤭) is a prefecture, also known as the Préfecture De Mali, located in the Labé Region of Guinea. The capital is Mali. The prefecture covers an area of 9,790 km.² and has an estimated population of 246,000.

regions.name: Macenta Prefecture
regions.title: Macenta Prefecture
text: Macenta is a prefecture located in the Nzérékoré Region of Guinea. The capital is Macenta. The prefecture covers an area of 7,056 km.² and has an estimated population of 278,456.

regions.name: Yomou Prefecture
regions.title: Yomou Prefecture
text: Yomou is a prefecture located in the Nzérékoré Region of Guinea. The capital and principal town of the prefecture is Yomou. The prefecture covers an area of 3,920 km.² and has an estimated population of 114,371.
As of 2005, Yomou town is estimated to have a population of around 12,000. The town is an important trading centre for the Guinea Highlands area.

regions.name: Nzérékoré Prefecture
regions.title: Nzérékoré Prefecture
text: Nzérékoré is a prefecture located in the Nzérékoré Region of Guinea. The capital is Nzérékoré. The prefecture covers an area of 3,632 square kilometres (1,402 sq mi) and has an estimated population of 396,949.

regions.name: Gaoual Prefecture
regions.title: Gaoual Prefecture
text: Gaoual is a prefecture located in the Boké Region of Guinea. The capital is Gaoual. The prefecture covers an area of 7,758 km.² and has a population of 194,245.

regions.name: Boké
regions.title: Boké Region
text: Boké Region (N'Ko: ߓߏ߬ߞߋ߫ ߕߌ߲߬ߞߎߘߎ߲) is located in western  Guinea. It is bordered by the countries of Senegal and Guinea-Bissau and the Guinean regions of Kindia and Labé.  Its capital is the city of Boké.

regions.name: Siguiri Prefecture
regions.title: Siguiri Prefecture
text: Siguiri is a prefecture located in the Kankan Region of Guinea. The capital is Siguiri. The prefecture covers an area of 18,500 km2 (7,100 sq mi) and has a population of 687,002.

regions.name: Koubia Prefecture
regions.title: Koubia Prefecture
text: Koubia (Pular: 𞤍𞤢𞤤𞤭𞥅𞤪𞤫 𞤑𞤵𞤦𞤭𞤴𞤢𞥄) is a prefecture located in the Labé Region of Guinea in the Fouta Djallon mountains. Fulas are the majority ethnic group in the region with Fula (Pular) as the primary language.  The capital is Koubia. The prefecture covers an area of 2,800 km.² and has an estimated population of 114,000.

regions.name: Tougué Prefecture
regions.title: Tougué Prefecture
text: Tougué (Pular: 𞤍𞤢𞤤𞤭𞥅𞤪𞤫 𞤚𞤵𞤺𞤫𞥅) is a prefecture located in the Labé Region of Guinea. The capital is Tougué. The prefecture covers an area of 6,400 km2. and has an estimated population of 132,000.

regions.name: Dinguiraye Prefecture
regions.title: Dinguiraye Prefecture
text: Dinguiraye is a prefecture located in the Faranah Region of Guinea. The capital is Dinguiraye. The prefecture covers an area of 7,965 km.² and has a population of 195,662.

regions.name: Boffa Prefecture
regions.title: Boffa Prefecture
text: Boffa is a prefecture located in the Boké Region of Guinea. The capital is Boffa. The prefecture covers an area of 5,050 km2 (1,950 mi2) and has a population of 287,648 (2025).

regions.name: Dubréka Prefecture
regions.title: Dubréka Prefecture
text: Dubréka is a prefecture located in the Kindia Region of Guinea. The capital is Dubréka. The prefecture covers an area of 4,350 km2 and has a population of 330,548.

regions.name: Conakry
regions.title: Conakry
text: Conakry ( KON-ə-kree, French: [kɔnakʁi]; Susu: Kɔnakiri; N'Ko: ߞߐߣߊߞߙߌ߫, romanized: Kɔnakrí; Fula: 𞤑𞤮𞤲𞤢𞥄𞤳𞤭𞤪𞤭, romanized: Konaakiri) is the capital and largest city of Guinea. A port city, it serves as the economic, financial and cultural centre of Guinea. Its population as of the 2025 Guinea census was 3,407,327, or around one-fifth of the country's population.

regions.name: Coyah Prefecture
regions.title: Coyah Prefecture
text: Coyah is a prefecture located in the Kindia Region of Guinea. The capital is Coyah. The prefecture covers an area of 1,375 km² and has a population of 263,861.

regions.name: Kissidougou Prefecture
regions.title: Kissidougou Prefecture
text: Kissidougou (N'Ko: ߞߛߌ߬ߘߎ߯ ߡߙߊ߬ߓߊ߰ߘߊ߮) is a prefecture located in the Faranah Region of Guinea. The capital is Kissidougou. The prefecture covers an area of 8,300 km² and has a population of 283,609.

The prefecture is largely savanna but villages are usually surrounded by semi-deciduous humid forests, termed “forest islands.” The composition, management, and use of these forests change based on the socioeconomic conditions and commercial signals experienced by the villages (e.g., being used as fortresses during warfare and growing coffee or fruit depending on market prices).

regions.name: Kérouané Prefecture
regions.title: Kérouané Prefecture
text: Kérouané is a prefecture located in the Kankan Region of Guinea. The capital is Kérouané. The prefecture covers an area of 7,020 km.² and has a population of 207,547.

regions.name: Télimélé Prefecture
regions.title: Télimélé Prefecture
text: Télimélé is a prefecture located in the Kindia Region of Guinea. The capital is Télimélé. The prefecture covers an area of 9,216 km.² and has an estimated population of 284,409.

regions.name: Lélouma Prefecture
regions.title: Lélouma Prefecture
text: Lélouma (Pular: 𞤂𞤫𞥅𞤤𞤵𞤥𞤢𞥄) is a prefecture located in the Labé Region of Guinea. The capital is Lélouma. The prefecture covers an area of 2,140 km.² In census of 2014, it had  population of 163,000.

regions.name: Dalaba Prefecture
regions.title: Dalaba Prefecture
text: Dalaba (Pular: 𞤍𞤢𞤤𞤭𞥅𞤪𞤫 𞤁𞤢𞤤𞤢𞤦𞤢𞥄) is a prefecture located in the Mamou Region of Guinea. The capital is Dalaba. The prefecture covers an area of 4,400 km² and has an estimated population of 155,000.

regions.name: Labé Prefecture
regions.title: Labé Prefecture
text: Labé (Pular: 𞤍𞤢𞤤𞤭𞥅𞤪𞤫 𞤂𞤢𞤦𞤫) is a prefecture in the Labé Region of Guinea. The capital is Labé. The prefecture covers an area of 3,014 km² and has an estimated population of 204,000.

regions.name: Pita Prefecture
regions.title: Pita Prefecture
text: Pita (Pular: 𞤍𞤢𞤤𞤭𞥅𞤪𞤫 𞤆𞤭𞤼𞤢) is a prefecture located in the Mamou Region of Guinea. The capital is Pita. The prefecture covers an area of 4,320 km.² and has an estimated population of 266,000.

regions.name: Kouroussa Prefecture
regions.title: Kouroussa Prefecture
text: Kouroussa is a prefecture located in the Kankan Region of Guinea. The capital is Kouroussa. The prefecture covers an area of 14,050 km.² and has a population of 268,630. With Kouroussa town by far the largest in the Prefecture numbering only 10,000, the vast majority of the Prefecture's population live in small rural communities, making their living from subsistence and small scale cash crop agriculture, as well as small scale trade and mining. The majority of the population are members of the Malinke ethnic group or related Mande speakers.  The eastern portion of the prefecture is formed from the Niger River valley, while most of the area characterized by low rolling hills and dry savanna grasslands or scrub-like forest.

regions.name: Fria Prefecture
regions.title: Fria Prefecture
text: Fria is a prefecture located in the Boké Region of Guinea. The capital is Fria. The prefecture covers an area of 2,016 km (1,253 mi).² and has a population of 96,527. It is the site of the first alumina factory in Africa.
